assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has intermittent symptoms and a need to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic instability
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances
CPT 93247 represents long-term continuous ECG monitoring
The denial was regarding coverage for diagnostic monitoring services
The appeal addresses the documented clinical need for CPT 93247
